extraction.title: Schumpeter
extraction.subtitle: America’s descent into state capitalism is exaggerated Particularly by the state
extraction.summary: The article critiques the notion that America is transitioning into state capitalism under President Trump, arguing that the government's attempts to control the economy are largely ineffective. It highlights the limitations of Trump's interventions in business and contrasts them with more robust state capitalism seen in other countries.
